identitySignals: Name matches registered nonprofit 'East Bay Community Foundation' in Oakland, CA (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer, EIN 94-6070996), matching the agenda's 'East Bay Community Foundation, Oakland, CA'
Its own site lists its address as 200 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Oakland, CA, matching the agenda location
EBCF's own page describes Oakland Goes Outdoors and the Riddell Family Fund, matching the agenda grant title 'Kathryn and Robert Riddell Fund - Oakland Goes Outdoors - Middle School Network'
research.notes: The grant is from a donor-advised fund (Riddell Family Fund) held at EBCF. eastbaycf.org (email domain) fails TLS handshake in some fetchers; ebcf.org is the working site.

profile.address: 200 Frank H. Ogawa Plaza, Oakland, CA 94612
profile.summary: A community foundation founded in 1928 that serves Alameda and Contra Costa counties in California. It makes grants, builds partnerships and does advocacy aimed at removing structural barriers and advancing racial equity for East Bay residents. It is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit based in Oakland.
